SASBDB entry SASDAC9  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDAC9/)

Publication: Crystal structure of the Varkud satellite ribozyme.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1038/nchembio.1929

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDAC9/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
